text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: What matters in this scoring profile

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: 50% for tool selection + error recovery / 5% for multi-step chains

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #176a85

g.text: 25% Tool selection

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Choose the operation that fits the request.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: get_weather instead of web_search.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17a39b

g.text: 25% Error recovery

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Handle errors without fabricating a result.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: surface a failed stock-price lookup.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7865ba

g.text: 20% Context & state

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Retain corrections and prior tool results.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: keep the revised meeting time.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #e4ad3a

g.text: 10% Arguments

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Pass the intended arguments accurately.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: use the requested temperature units.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc795a

g.text: 10% Planning

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Break a goal into useful operations.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: resolve contacts, create event, notify.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: 5% Multi-step chains

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Respect dependencies, with a smaller weight.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: read a found file before emailing it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: 5% Code patterns

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Basic code-oriented tool behavior.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Example: read the source before proposing a fix.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: 0% Safety & structured output

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Also zero: restraint, localization, structured reasoning,

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: instruction following, toolset scale and composition.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Score = sum of weight x (earned category points / available category points)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Exact fractions are used before rounding. One lost point in selection or recovery changes the score by 25/6 = 4.17.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183149

g.text: Tool-Eval-Bench by SeraphimSerapis | github.com/SeraphimSerapis/tool-eval-bench

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607386

g.text: Examples paraphrase test expectations. Six selection/recovery scenarios supply half the score: small samples matter.
